## Installation
Set environment variables to point to the `cmdstan` installation path. Open the R environment file using 
```
usethis::edit_r_environ()
```
and add the following 
```
CMDSTAN = "/users/xzhou2/cmdstan/" # JHPCE
CMDSTAN_INSTALL = "implicit"
```

Then install the `fli` package using 
```
remotes::install_github("xinkai-zhou/fli", auth_token = "")
```

You'll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md` up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this. You could also use GitHub Actions to re-render `README.Rmd` every time you push. An example workflow can be found here: <https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v1/examples>.
